opening.argument: The video is structured as a medical entrance-exam revision lecture: the presenter says the session will teach concepts for future exams, introduces CT perfusion imaging, and explains its three parameters. The instruction also covers how to differentiate pancreatic cystic lesions using findings from an endoscopic-ultrasound cyst fluid aspirate. Those spoken explanations support the educational purpose of the slides and lecture. The direction to download the DocTutorials app is presented as access to exam preparation, not as a request for money, credentials, or financial participation; references to following the channel likewise function as ordinary audience engagement.
